verdict.rationale: The CLI documents `skills list` (alias `ls`, "similar to `npm ls`") for listing installed skills and `skills remove` with per-agent targeting (e.g. `--agent claude-code cursor my-skill`), so both listing and removal are first-party capabilities. Nothing shows that removal is clean, though: no evidence covers deleting the canonical copy behind the recommended symlinks or confirming no leftover files remain, and one community commenter said uninstalls aren't documented. missing for 10: documented behavior on whether remove deletes the canonical copy and symlinks without orphans, assurance that no lingering instructions remain in agent dirs or skills-lock.json, hands-on verification of remove/list output.
